title: Create: Central Kitchen
description: Offering more tools and methods to automate food processing of other mod in Create.
body: Welcome to Create: Central Kitchen 2.0, a mod offering more tools and methods to automate food processing for other mods in Create. Create: Central Kitchen has been redesigned for version 2.0, and the content of version 1.0 will be divided into three modules, corresponding to three separate mods: - Farming Automation: Create: Integrated Farming ; - Cooking Automation: Create: Central Kitchen; - Ingredients & Recipes: In developement Create: Culinary Inventions; We currently offer: Unpack ingredients with Packagers into Cooking Pots from Farmer’s Delight and its addons, Kegs from Brewin’ and Chewin’ , Chillers and Ovens from Extra Delight , and Casks from Hearth & Harvest . Use Mechanical Arms with supported Cooking Pots , Skillets , Stoves , Cutting Boards , Chillers , Ovens , Braziers , and Casks . Automate servings from Farmer’s Delight Feasts and Pies , Cultural Delights’ Eggplant Parmesan , Rustic Delight’s Pancake Stacks , and Festive Delight’s Festive Chicken . Use all supported Boiler Heaters as cooking heat sources and active heaters to speed up Cooking Pots and Skillets . Use supported freezer sources with Brewin’ and Chewin’ Kegs . Convert Farmer’s Delight Cutting Board recipes into Create Sawing and Deploying recipes. Convert Brewin’ and Chewin’ Keg Pouring recipes into Create Filling and Emptying recipes, while prioritizing native Create recipes. Convert Extra Delight Mortar and Juicer recipes into Pressing , Melting Pot recipes into Mixing , and Gingerbread Decorating into Deploying . Generate Sawing recipes for stripping logs, producing bark—or straw from bamboo-like blocks. If you'd like to add more things, please suggest them to us here! Installation Requirements Create & Create: Dragons Plus Legacy 1.+ Feature We currently offer: Pie Overhaul : Overhaul vanilla and modded pies in Farmer's Delight style, with placable blocks and slices. Cake Slice Integration: Add cake slices for non Farmer's Delight add-ons. Fluid Integration : Provide fluid for sauces, drinks, ice creams and more! Recipe Integration : Added hundreds of integration recipes in Create style, including Sequenced Assembly Recipes for Sandwiches, Burgers and Pies. Reasonable Automatic Mixing : Shapeless Recipes with certain container items (Glass Bottle, Bowl, Bucket) involved are now excluded from Automatic Mixing. Smarter Upright on Belt : Items with certain containers (Glass Bottle, Bowl, Bucket) are now automatically rendered upright on belt, without needing specifying item tag create:upright on belt. Specifically, when Farmer's Delight is installed: Blaze Stove : Give your Blaze a guide and turn it into a master chef! Blaze Stove will provide Mechanical Arm support for kitchenwares including: Cooking Pot (Farmer's Delight), Kettle (Farmer's Respite), Copper Pot (Miner's Delight). Blaze Stove can also boost cooking up to 4x for the kitchenware above! Cutting Board Recipe Automation : Deployer can now perform Cutting Board Recipes (Farmer's Delight) on Belt and Depot. Smarter Basket : Basket (Farmer's Delight) can now directly interact with Belt and Mechanical Arm. Harvester Compat: Harvester is now compatible with Mushroom Colonies (Farmer's Delight), Tea Bush (Farmer's Respite), Coffee (Farmer's Respite), Propelplant (Nether's Delight), Lime Bush (Collector's Reap), Pomegranate Bush (Collector's Reap) Installation Requirements: Forge Create Supported Mods: Create: Craft & Additions Create: Confectionery Farmer's Delight Farmer's Respite (1.20.1 Partial Support) Miner's Delight + Nether's Delight Atmospheric Autumnity Buzzier Bees Environmental Neapolitan Upgrade Aquatic Peculiars Seasonals Respiteful (1.18.2-1.19.2) Abnormal Delight Collector's Reap Cookielicious (1.18.2) Overweight Farming End's Delight Corn Delight

title: Small Ships
description: Vanilla friendly Ships for Minecraft. Now with cannons!
body: Small Ships Medieval-inspired ships for exploration, trade, and naval battles! Play with Friends! Want to play together with your friends? Check out DatHost for the best performance and easy setup! How to Get Started Go to DatHost using my Link Register your account. Once registered, choose the plan that fits your needs The 30% discount will be applied automatically at checkout. Important: The discount only works if you order your server using this my Link ! Showcase Official Addons Small Ships Addon SmallShipsAddon : Adds four ships to Small Ships: the Rowing Boat, the Fishing Boat, the Early Cog and the Early Caravel. Viking Addon SmallShipsAddon : Adds three Viking ships to Small Ships: the Knarr, the Longship and the Transport Drakkar. My Other Mods Villager Recruits : Command your own Villager Army into war! Now with Diplomacy and Factions ! Villager Workers : Hire Villagers and let them work for you ! Siege Weapons : Prepare for war. Build your siege weapon. Dominate the battlefield! Explanation Craft a Dockyard and place it next to water. Right-click the Dockyard, choose a ship and a wood type and press "Build ship". The materials are taken from your inventory. The finished ship is placed in the water near the Dockyard. The water has to be wide and deep enough. Right-click the ship to board. The first player gets the helm. Other players get the free seat closest to where they clicked. Press R to open/close the sail. W / S to increase or decrease the sail. A / D to steer. The keys for your seat are shown on screen when you board. Ships can only be built at the Dockyard. There are no crafting recipes for ships. Ships can be lost. A sunken ship can not be recovered. Controls Helm Key Action R Open / close the sail W / S More / less sail (4 steps). With closed sail: move slowly forward / backward A / D Steer W Row (Galley and Drakkar) Hold right mouse button Aim the cannons on the side you are looking at Right mouse button + mouse wheel Change ammo Space Shoot E (inventory key) Open ship inventory Mouse wheel Camera distance in third person Gunner Key Action Hold right mouse button Aim your cannon Right mouse button + mouse wheel Change ammo Space Shoot your cannon Other Right-click another spot of the ship with an empty hand to change your seat. Right-click a cannon to sit at it as gunner. Crouch + right-click to open the inventory from outside of the ship. Right-click a mob while sitting in the ship to take it on board. Right-click a mob on the ship to dismount it. The sail key can be changed in the options. The other keys use your vanilla key binds. Dockyard Materials are taken from your inventory. Every job takes time. In creative mode it is free and instant. Nobody can board a ship while the Dockyard works on it. Build Choose the ship and one of the 9 wood types. Any planks can be used. The wood type only changes the look of the ship. The Dockyard shows the attributes and the wind profile of the ship before you build it. Bigger ships need deeper water. The Dockyard tells you if the water is too shallow or if there is not enough room. Ship Planks White Wool String Iron Build time Galley 96 24 12 18 nuggets 2:00 min Drakkar 96 24 12 36 nuggets 2:00 min Dhow 96 48 48 none 2:00 min Caravel 120 48 24 30 nuggets 2:15 min Cog 192 24 12 48 nuggets 3:00 min Brigg 240 48 24 8 ingots 3:30 min Galleon 336 72 36 12 ingots 4:30 min Modify Works on a ship within 16 blocks of the Dockyard. Install or remove upgrades. Mount or remove cannons. Hang shields on the Drakkar. Change sail color, mast banner and sail banner. Rename the ship. Repair hull and sails. Removed cannons, shields and banners are given back. Removed upgrades give back 30% of the material. Ships These are the default values. All of them can be changed in the config. Ship Hull Speed Turning Slots Cannons Seats Water Cog 400 HP 27 km/h 4.0 108 4 11 cold Brigg 500 HP 30 km/h 3.0 162 6 17 cold Galley 200 HP 35 km/h 5.0 54 2 12 warm Drakkar 200 HP 28 km/h 5.0 54 0 15 cold Caravel 250 HP 32 km/h 4.75 81 4 10 any Dhow 200 HP 32 km/h 4.5 135 4 12 warm Galleon 700 HP 25 km/h 1.5 216 10 34 any A mounted cannon can take up one seat. Cog Trade ship with one mast (cold water). Up to 4 cannons, 2 on each side. Best with tail wind. Brigg Trade ship with two masts (cold water). Up to 6 cannons, 3 on each side. Best with tail wind. Galley Warship with one sail and oars (warm water). Up to 2 cannons, 1 on each side. With oars it reaches 85% of its speed in any wind. Takes no hull damage when it rams another ship. Best with side wind. Drakkar Viking ship with one sail and oars (cold water). With oars it reaches 75% of its speed in any wind. Up to 10 shields, 5 on each side. Each shield reduces the damage to the ship by 3%. Breaks ice. Best with tail wind. Caravel Ship with two masts. Up to 4 cannons, 2 on each side. Can sail against the wind. Best with head wind and side wind. Same speed in every biome. Dhow Trade ship with two masts (warm water). Up to 4 cannons, 2 on each side. Cargo does not slow it down. Best with side wind. Galleon The biggest ship, with three masts. Up to 10 cannons, 5 on each side. Cannons do not slow it down. Same speed in every biome. Best with tail wind. Detailed Features Wind The wind changes direction and strength every few minutes. It is stronger in rain and thunder. White lines on the water show the wind direction while you are on a ship. The banner on the mast shows it too. Every ship has its own wind profile. The table shows the speed change at full wind strength with full sail. A ship can not get faster than its max speed. Oars are not affected by the wind. The sail closes when nobody is at the helm. Ship Head wind Side wind Tail wind Cog -70% +10% +50% Brigg -75% +20% +40% Galley -30% +40% 0% Drakkar -70% +10% +40% Caravel +10% +15% -20% Dhow -40% +20% 0% Galleon -100% -20% +50% Ship Performance Cold-water ships → 20% faster in cold biomes, 20% slower in warm. Warm-water ships → 20% faster in warm biomes, 20% slower in cold. Both are 5% slower in biomes that are neither cold nor warm. Each cannon decreases speed by 2.5% (not on the Galleon). Cargo can decrease speed by up to 10% (not on the Dhow). Torn sails give 25% less speed. Destroyed sails give no speed. Cannons Cannons are mounted at the Dockyard. Each cannon needs one Ship Cannon item. Remove a cannon at the Dockyard or in the ship inventory (click and hold). At the helm you aim and shoot all cannons on the side you are looking at. A gunner aims and shoots only his own cannon. The helm does not shoot cannons that have a gunner. While aiming, the camera is on the barrel and a line shows where the shot goes. Ammo is taken from the ship inventory first, then from the inventory of the shooter. The HUD shows the available ammo while aiming. Reloading takes about 4 seconds. A hit on the mast damages the sails. A hit on the hull damages the hull. Hits on a ship throw wood debris and sail shreds. Cannonballs that hit the ground make a small explosion. Passengers can not damage their own ship. Ammo Cannon Ball → normal shot, best against the hull. Chained Shot → 25% less range and damage, heavy damage to sails. Grape Shot → short range, best against the crew. Fine-Grain Powder → used up when shooting, +50% range. Ground Cannon Use the Ship Cannon item on the ground to place it. Right-click to use it. W / S to move, A / D to turn. Hold the right mouse button to aim. Double right-click turns the barrel back to the front. Shoot with Space . Ammo is taken from your inventory. Ramming Ships damage each other when they collide at 20 km/h or more. More speed means more damage. The smaller ship takes more damage and gets pushed away. The crew of both ships takes damage too. Hitting land at high speed damages your own ship. A sailing ship pushes and damages mobs in its way. Sinking Ships do not repair themselves. A ship with no hull HP left sinks with a sinking animation. The crew is thrown into the water. A sunken ship is lost. It can not be repaired, boarded or picked up. The wreck despawns after 15 minutes and drops its cargo and cannons. Ship Repairing Hull: right-click with an iron nugget while you have planks in your inventory. Works up to 66% hull. Sail patching: right-click with string while you have an iron nugget in your inventory. Works up to 33% sail. Dockyard: repairs hull and sails completely. Costs 4 planks and 1 iron nugget per 10 hull HP and 1 wool per 5 sail HP. Ship Upgrades Iron Scantlings → +100% hull HP. Copper Plating → +20% turning. Cotton Sails → +10% speed. Upgrades are installed at the Dockyard. Bigger ships need more items: Ship Iron Scantlings Copper Plating Cotton Sails Cog 4 4 1 Brigg 12 8 4 Galley 5 4 1 Drakkar 5 5 1 Caravel 5 4 2 Dhow 3 3 2 Galleon 16 12 8 Inventory Hoppers can put items into the ship inventory and take them out. The ship inventory shows speed and damage of the ship. Cannons, banners and shields can be removed in the ship inventory (click and hold). Sail Coloring Right-click with dye to color sails. Banners Right-click with a banner to put it on the mast. Shears remove it. A banner pattern can be put on the sail at the Dockyard. Shields Right-click the Drakkar with a shield to hang it up. An axe removes it. Shields with banner patterns are supported. Epic Knights shields are supported. Ship Naming Use a nametag to name your ship, or rename it at the Dockyard. Leashing Right-click a ship with a lead to pull it. Right-click a fence to tie the ship to it. A leashed ship can not sail. Other Decks are walkable. Mobs can be passengers. NPCs standing on the deck leave onto nearby land when the ship lies still. All ships break lily pads. Bubble columns do not affect ships. Water animals swim away from ships. Vanilla boats are 75% slower by default. Crafting Dockyard Ship Cannon (any log) Cannon Ball Gunpowder in the middle, 4 iron nuggets on the sides. Gives 2. Chained Shot Chain in the middle, 4 Cannon Balls in the corners. Gives 2. Grape Shot Gunpowder in the middle, 8 iron nuggets around it. Fine-Grain Powder Iron Scantlings Copper Plating Cotton Sails Config Server config ( smallships-server.toml , in the serverconfig folder of the world). Server values are synced to the clients. Attributes for each ship: hull HP, speed, turning, acceleration, inventory size, water type. Changes apply to existing ships. dockyardBuildableShips : ships that can be built at the Dockyard. Empty = all ships. Upgrades: enable, cost, time, refund and strength. Wind: enable, change interval, minimum strength in rain and thunder. Cannon damage, block destruction, sail damage, collision damage, shield damage reduction. Speed modifiers for cargo, cannons and biomes. mountBlackList : entities that can not mount a ship. driverEntities : non-player entities that can take the helm (default: recruits:captain ). Vanilla boat speed, despawn time of sunken ships, updateCheckerEnable . Client config ( smallships-client.toml , in the config folder) Speed unit: km/h, m/s, knots or mph. Camera: auto third person, camera centered on the ship, zoom distance. Wind particles and banner movement. Creative tab, updateCheckerEnable . Commands /smallships wind shows the wind direction and strength. /smallships wind setDirection <0-360 sets the wind direction (north = 0, clockwise). Needs OP. /smallships wind setStrength <0-1 sets the wind strength. Needs OP. Update checker Shows a chat message with a download link when a new version is available. Datapacks and Addons Dockyard recipes can be changed with a datapack. One file per ship: data/ /dockyard recipes/ .json . build time is in ticks. { "build time": 3600, "ingredients": [ { "tag": "minecraft:planks", "count": 192 }, { "item": "minecraft:white wool", "count": 24 }, { "item": "minecraft:string", "count": 12 }, { "item": "minecraft:iron nugget", "count": 48 } ] } Addon mods can add their own ships with the ship registry. Registered ships show up in the Dockyard. ShipRegistry.register(ShipType.builder(new ResourceLocation("myaddon", "longship"), LongshipEntity::summon) .buildTime(110 20) .ingredient(ItemTags.PLANKS, 112) .ingredient(Items.WHITE WOOL, 20) .build()); The Fabric version needs Fabric API. Modpack Permissions You are allowed to use the Small Ships Mod in any modpack, as long as you link back to this page and don’t make money off of it.

title: Wizards (RPG Series)
description: 🧙🏻‍♂️ Destroy your enemies with Arcane, Fire and Frost magic
body: 🧙🏻‍♂️ Destroy your enemies with Arcane, Fire and Frost magic! ✨ Discover more of the RPG Series 📦 Installation Required Armor Model API Runes Spell Engine Strongly recommended Better Combat for proper weapon mechanics 🧙🏻‍♂️ Features This project adds RPG-style combat focused skill sets—commonly known as classes—, introducing different variants of the wizard archetype (inspired by World of Warcraft). Getting started Obtain a Wands or Staff , these all have a basic spell attached. Runes serve as ammunition for casted spells (much like arrows for bows). More information about crafting runes. Spell Books Become a true Wizard by creating a Spell Book, and unlocking all of its powerful spells! To do it, find a Spell Binding Table in village Gazebos, or build your own (just don't forget bookshelves around the Spell Binding Table). To use the spell books: equip them and hold a weapon! Tome of Arcane Offers focused arcane spells, best used against solitary or closely gathered opponents. Tome of Fire Offers rampant fire spells, best used to deal damage at large areas. Tome of Frost Offers chilling frost spells, best used to damage enemies, hinder their movement, and shield yourself. Wizard equipment Explore craftable equipment, boosting the power and speed of your spells: material tiered wizard robes of various kinds material tiered staves and wands Equipment bonuses are configureable in config/wizards/items.json . Magical enchantments Unlock powerful enchantments for spell casting, for example: Spell Infinity to cast spells without Rune cost Spell Power to increase spell damage in general Spell Haste to increase spell casting speed Discover even more in-game! Use Enchantment Descriptions! Enchantments are configureable in config/spell power/enchantments.json . Extended dungeon loot Find magic equipment in dungeon loot chests! Loot table injections are configurable in config/rpg series/loot.json . New village structures Find Wizard Towers in villages, where Wizard Merchant villagers sell magic equipment! The spawn weight and limit are configureable in config/wizards/villages.json . 🔧 Configuration Spell casting mechanics and HUD can be configured under Mod Menu / Spell Engine / Settings . All spells are defined in data files, hence customisable via data packs. Find the original data files in the project source linked to this page. Item attributes of wizard equipment, chest loot chances, village structure generation can be configured by changing config JSON files under config/wizards/ Designed for multiplayer Create your own RPG server. Using our promo code gets you cheaper prices and also supports us. 🎁 Looking for even more content? Discover a wide range of Spell Engine mods, made by our beloved partners!

title: TMCraft
description: Cobblemon side mod that adds TMs with crafting recipes

title: The Graveyard (Fabric/Neoforge)
description: A mod that adds structures, mobs, bosses and blocks themed around the graveyard.
body: Structures, mobs, blocks and a boss with a graveyard theme. Graveyards, crypts and overrun villages, the Corrupted Champion in its prison, and a Chronicle that collects the lore. Versions: 1.20 to 1.20.1, 1.21.1, 1.21.7 to 1.21.8, 1.21.11, 26.1.2, 26.2, 26.3 Forge 1.20.1: The Graveyard (Forge) Boss music "Incarnated Evil" thanks to Rotch Gwylt Support my work on The Graveyard adds graveyards, crypts and undead to the Overworld. Small graves generate in plains, deserts, savannas and on mountains. Larger graveyards generate in forests and taigas, a haunted house in the dark forest, and a crypt in the caves far below. The undead spawn at night, and a horde can appear near a player. Overrun villages are burnt-out vanilla villages: charred and scorched houses, smoldering embers, skeletons, corrupted illagers on guard and flocks of crows. At night tormented villagers wander through the ruins. Ringing a bell redeems them. If nobody rings it, they fade away at dawn. The lore is written in the Chronicle. Its 36 pages come in two ways: 19 lie as Lore Books in structures of the mod, and the other 17 are in chests. The Corrupted Champion waits in its prison above the ocean. Structures Structure Where it generates Small Grave forests and plains Small Graveyard plains and meadows Small Desert Grave, Small Desert Graveyard deserts Small Savanna Grave savannas and badlands Small Mountain Grave peaks, slopes, groves, meadows and cherry groves Medium Graveyard forests, flower forests and windswept forests Large Graveyard taigas and snowy taigas Crypt underground in cave biomes, between Y -40 and -10 Haunted House dark forests, swamps and old growth taigas Ruins forests Altar snowy plains and ice spikes The Corrupted Champion's prison at Y 210 above deep and frozen oceans Dead Tree dark forests and swamps Memorial Tree birch forests Giant Mushroom mushroom fields and swamps Mushroom Grave mushroom fields, jungles and swamps Overrun Village plains and meadows, deserts, savannas, snowy plains and taigas, one variant for each Mobs The undead Ghoul , Revenant and Nightmare roam at night. Ghouls and Revenants burn in daylight. Skeleton Creeper : an undead creeper. It swells before it explodes. By default the explosion does not break blocks. Wraith : can rise when you open a coffin or sarcophagus below ground. It puts out torches and other lights near it. Reaper : off by default, can be turned on in the config. The corrupted Acolyte : an illager in the service of the Corruption. It drops the Bone Dagger. Corrupted Vindicator , Corrupted Pillager and Corrupted Evoker : undead illagers that guard the overrun villages. Tormented Villager : appears in overrun villages at night. Weapons do not hurt it. Ring a bell within 48 blocks to redeem it and get experience. Left alone, it fades away at dawn. Nameless Hanged : a trader that only deals at night. It takes Corruption, which the mobs of this mod drop, as payment. Birds Raven : sits on gravestones, fences, walls and leaves. Crow : flies in flocks, eats crops and scatters when startled. Crows keep away from scarecrows: a carved pumpkin or jack o'lantern on a hay bale with a fence next to or under the bale, or an armor stand that wears a pumpkin. Magpie : picks up shiny items from the ground, such as nuggets, ingots, raw ores and gems. Hit it and it drops what it took. The Ghouling Use a bone staff on a block to raise a Ghouling. It follows you, fights for you and waits when told to. You can draw it into the staff and set it down again somewhere else. Give it a coffin or a sarcophagus and it carries 54 slots of items and picks up what lies around. How to get a bone staff is in the spoiler under The Corrupted Champion. Blocks and items Skeleton decorations : 39 skeletons, skulls and bone piles in normal and wither versions. They are carved from bone blocks in the Ossuary . Gravestones in 13 stone types. You can write on them like on a sign. Urns : glazed urns and small urns in 16 colors, and large terracotta urns in 17 variants. Urns store items. Coffins in 11 wood types and the Sarcophagus , both with storage. Dark Iron : ingot, block, door, trapdoor and bars. The door and trapdoor open with redstone. With the config option darkIronOpensByHand set to true , you can also open them by hand. Fire Brazier , Soul Fire Brazier , Candle Holder , Small Pillar and Ceramics . Charred and scorched wood from the overrun villages: planks, logs, wood, stairs, slabs, fences, fence gates, doors and trapdoors, plus Smoldering Debris. Eight logs around a piece of charcoal make scorched logs, eight scorched pieces around charcoal make charred ones. Light them with flint and steel or a fire charge and they smolder. Put them out with a shovel or a water bucket. Lore Book : lay a Chronicle page down in the world as a Lore Book for the next player. Bone Dagger , Vial of Blood , Corruption and the music disc "Incarnated Evil" by Rotch Gwylt. The Corrupted Champion The Corrupted Champion is what is left of a hero who fell to the Corruption. It waits at the altar of its prison above the ocean and rises when a full Vial of Blood is used on the altar. Summoning the Corrupted Champion (spoiler) Summoning Find the three Ominous Bone Staff Fragments : the upper, the middle and the lower piece. Each Ruins structure holds one of them. Break the fragment to take it. The Nameless Hanged sometimes sells a fragment for 64 Corruption, or a map to the Ruins. Get a Bone Dagger . Craft it from bones or take it from an Acolyte. Keep a glass bottle in your offhand or hotbar and kill villagers with the Bone Dagger. The first kill turns the bottle into a Vial of Blood . Eight kills fill it. Go to the Corrupted Champion's prison. Seven blocks in front of the altar, three blocks of Corrupted Deepslate give off soul particles. Place one fragment on top of each of them: the middle piece on the middle block, the upper and the lower piece on the two outer blocks. At night, and not on Peaceful, use the full vial on the altar. The fragments vanish, the vial empties and the Champion rises. The fight The fight has three phases, each with its own health bar. Revenants and ghouls join the fight. Phase 1: the Champion stays at its altar. Up close it strikes with a soul beam that throws you back. It casts falling corpses across the arena, fangs, cursed skulls and levitation. Below 300 health it teleports you away and heals while you get wither and mining fatigue. Damage stops the healing. Phase 2: it rises again and hunts you for 40 seconds. It is faster, hits harder, charges at you, blinds you and pulls you close. It cannot be hurt while it hunts. Then it goes back to its altar and stands stunned for 30 seconds. Hit it then. Phase 3: its body breaks and it crawls. It is faster, chases you and pounces at you from a few blocks away. The reward The Champion drops a bone staff in one of five colors: white, black, red, cyan or purple. The staff calls a Ghouling. As soon as a bone staff is in your inventory, the staff recipes unlock. From then on you can also craft a staff from the three Ominous Bone Staff Fragments and a dye of the color you want. Configuration File: graveyard.json5 , in the graveyard folder of the loader's config directory. Structures : each one on or off, with a generation chance. The height of the crypt and of the prison can be changed. Mobs : each one on or off. Most mobs also have spawn weight, group size, burning in daylight, and health, damage and speed factors. Hordes : on or off, how often they come, how far from the player and whether only at night. Corrupted Champion : summoning, spell durations and cooldowns, the phase change, the number of summoned mobs, darker sky and fog, and the boss music. Behaviour : magpies taking items, crows eating crops, the Ghouling picking up items, wraiths putting out lights, the Skeleton Creeper's explosion radius and block damage, smoldering blocks in villages, the urn inventory size and the number of trades of the Nameless Hanged. Chronicle : the inventory button, the toast for each found page and pages in chest loot. Particles : fog and ash. The option structuresOnly stops all natural mob spawns, spawners and hordes of this mod. Spawn eggs and commands still work. A config from 3.x ( the-graveyard-3.0-config.json5 ) is read once to create graveyard.json5 . The old file is left as it is. More mods by LithiumPlus VillagersPlus : new villager types, trades and workstations. VillagersTradingPlus : add, replace or delete the trades of any villager, change the currency and gate trades behind conditions, all from a datapack. Nyctophobia : dark, foggy and unsettling biomes for the Overworld. DataDrivenVillagers (CurseForge): create and change villager professions from JSON files or an in-game editor. VanillaTales is a collection of small, independent mods that add little stories to vanilla content. Install only the ones you want. The links go to CurseForge. Golem Patrol : iron golems patrol by day, stand watch by night and rally to a ringing bell. Zombie Sieges : turns a vanilla zombie siege into a real event, with a ringing bell, a boss bar and two waves of zombies. Sherd Stories : gives every decorated pot a title and the story of where its sherds were found. Ghost Crews : gives every shipwreck a name and a crew of drowned that guard it until it is looted clean. Illager Scouts : a pillager scout watches your village and warns you two days before a patrol arrives. Occupied Villages : some new villages spawn already occupied by an illager garrison you can liberate. Bonded Pairs : binds two mobs from the same spawn group into a pair that avenges each other. Raid Aftermath : villagers repair the damage a raid or an explosion left in the village. Wayfarer's Landmarks : shows a title and helpful icons when you enter a structure.

title: Boat Break Fix
description: Fixes a bug where boats can be destroyed while falling on specific heights.
body: BBF stays true to the vanilla boat's behaviour, which "works as intended" according to Mojang. This is only a hotfix to prevent accidental deaths. Boat Break Fix is a simple mod that fixes the annoying bug where if you fall from a distance equivalent to 12, 13, 49, 51, 111, 114, 198, 202, 310, or 315 blocks with a boat, it'll break on landing, and you will recieve the equivalent fall damage. Not to be confused with the Boat Fall mod, which does the opposite of BBF. (Enables fall damage using boats) This mod just fixes that, while also increasing boat performance as less code is running on each tick, and yes, the mod does work with unlimited world heights. In case you want to know which specific heights are affected in vanilla, you can use f(n) = (25n^2 ± n)/2 where n is an integer. A video example of this bug can be seen in this reddit post (Which inspired me to make this mod altogether) Why did I die?? Boat shoud absorb impact of block (reddit.com) Hopefully Mojang fixes this in future updates. Meanwhile, this mod was tested working on all 3 main platforms from 1.17 to 1.19.2.

title: Automobility
description: Vehicle mod adding customizable and functional cars
body: A Minecraft mod adding customizable vehicles. Automobility is currently in BETA! The mod isn't feature-complete, and any feature requests would be greatly appreciated. Discuss features on the mod's GitHub Discussions page, or in the Discord. Available for Fabric and NeoForge Requires Fabric API (Fabric) No additional mods required for NeoForge Currently in alpha for Minecraft 1.21.1, older versions are retired. Supports Data Packs and Resource Packs Add your own custom vehicle types with data packs and resource packs! Here is an example that you can use as a template. Getting Started Recipes: Crafting table recipes can be viewed using EMI or JEI . Automobile part recipes are viewed in the Auto Mechanic Table's GUI. Automobile Parts: Craft an Auto Mechanic Table. Use the GUI to craft the frame, engine, and wheels for your automobile. You can optionally craft an attachment. Building your Automobile: Craft an Automobile Assembler, as well as a Crowbar. Place parts on the assembler until the vehicle is complete. Use a crowbar to destroy the vehicle. Enhancing your Automobile: Use your Auto Mechanic Table to craft attachments, which can be placed on your Automobile to add exciting functionality or utility. Building: You can use Slopes, Dash Panels, Off-Road tiles and more to build roads, racetracks, or obstacle courses. title: CobbleCuisine
description: Snacks and treats for your Cobblemon adventures!
body: This mod is an addon for Cobblemon 1.6, 1.7, and 1.8 that adds a number of food items to the game, such as Curries, Sandwiches and Shakes. These foods give various Cobblemon-themed effects and boosts to the player and their Cobblemon. Foods and Drinks Added: As of v1.2.1, the added foods are of the following types. All items use a mix of vanilla Minecraft ingredients as well as items from Cobblemon, such as Berries. Curries, Sandwiches and Other Dishes : 🍲 Inspired by the games, these are food items that, apart from healing, allow you to make certain Types of Pokemon spawns more likely by giving you special Spawn Effects when consumed. These foods give you Type Spawn Effects, Egg Group Spawn Effects, EV Yield Spawn Effects, IV Spawn Effects, Shiny Spawn Effects, and Size Spawn Effects . 2.2.0 adds Herd Effects and Alpha Effects . Roasted Berries 🍉: Roast wild Berries on a campfire to gain effects and heal hearts, but don't overdo them - sometimes they might have bad effects! The 18 type damage reducing berries + Enigma berry when roasted allow for Tera Type Spawns. - Poke Puffs and Malasadas: 🍩 These are food items from the games that can be used to raise the Friendship of your Pokemon . While all Poke Puffs will have an identical Friendship boost, the Friendship boost from Malasadas will depend on the Pokemon's nature. Poke Beans: 🫘 Poke Beans come in different colours (Red, Blue, Green, Yellow and Orange). Bean Seeds can be obtained from Short Grass, and can be planted to grow into Beanstalks. Beans can also be found inside Chests in Villages. Along with other ingredients, Beans are used to make the new food items added in this update. Beans, Poke Puffs and Malasadas are normally usable on owned Pokemon, but they can also be consumed by the player if sneaking, with all of them giving unique Effects. Drinks and Shakes: 🍹 Berry Shakes that boost Pokemon EVs when consumed. The amount of EVs boosted depends on the Berries used. Also includes the Fruit Punch from Scarlet / Violet, Protein Smoothie from Pokemon Sleep, and four Drinks from Cafe ReMix: Teddiursa Iced Coffee 🥤 Lilligant Floral Tea 🥤 Miltank Mix Au Lait 🥤 Bouncy Brionne Soda 🥤 Salads and Sauces: Four Salad items made with Sauces that boost or reduce the chances of Herds or Alpha Pokemon spawning. The Sauces can also be used as seasonings to apply the same boosts to other foods. Deluxe Sauces also have other seasoning exclusive effects: increase Duration of any effect, increase Hidden Ability chances. Boosts and Effects Added: As of 2.2.0, the following Effects are implemented by the foods from this mod: Type Spawn Power 🔥 : Spawn Pokemon of specific Types . Egg Group Spawn Power 🪺 : Spawn Pokemon from all the Egg Groups . Tera Type Spawn Power : Spawn Pokemon with specific Tera Types . EV Yield Power ⚔️ : Spawn Pokemon with EV Yields of specific Stats; an effect for each Stat. IV Power 🧬 : Spawn Pokemon with higher IVs . Shiny Power ✨ : Increased chance to spawn Shiny Pokemon . Exp Power 📈 : Increased Experience Gain for the entire party Catch Power 🎊 : Increased Catch Rates . Size Spawn Power 🔎 : Spawn larger or smaller sized Pokemon. Herd Spawn Power : Spawn herds more or less frequently. Alpha Spawn Power : Spawn Alphas more or less frequently. Addon Packs (Not Updated): CobbleCuisine x Last Resort CobbleCuisine Delight CobbleCuisine Friends Works on NeoForge with Sinytra Connector and Fabric Language Kotlin Recipes Documentation (outdated) Effect durations and effectiveness can be configured through Mod Menu. Combine Effects from different foods to make hunting for specific Pokemon easier! (Note: You must be in the proper biome; for example, eating food that spawns Ice types inside a fiery biome will have no effect!) Still in beta, make backups of your worlds before installing. Credits to the amazing Cobblemon developers!

Forge? There is a forge port however I do not maintain it. Sinytra Connector might also work. description: Particular is a mod that enhances Minecraft's ambience with many hand-crafted visual effects.
body: Particular is a mod that enhances Minecraft's ambience with many hand-crafted visual effects. Support on Discord ! ⚠️ 1.20.1 and before, the mod is required on server ⚠️ Visual Effects 3D water splashes Anything that falls into water throws up a splash in the color of that water. Leaf snow Snow-covered leaves shed clumps of snow that break into powder, more often while it is snowing. Cold breath Players and mobs breathe visibly in cold biomes and at high altitude. Sprinting makes them breathe faster. Footstep dust Sprinting or landing on sand, dirt, gravel or snow kicks up dust in the color of the ground, in place of the vanilla block chips. Tumbling bushes Dead bushes roll and bounce across deserts, more often during storms. Embers Campfires give off glowing embers, blue for soul campfires. Lit furnaces, blast furnaces and smokers spit sparks. Cave dust Dust hangs in the air underground, thicker the deeper you go and the less sunlight reaches you. title: EEEAB 's Mobs
description: EEEAB's Mobs adds a variety of challenging monsters to your Minecraft world.
body: EEEAB's Mobs adds a variety of challenging monsters to your Minecraft world. Custom Boss Bar Tutorial Boss descriptions Relic Annihilator Relic Annihilator — one of Ancient Steve's creations, once took part in the war against The Immortal. Relying on its pair of wheel-feet and rear thrusters, it gained astonishing mobility; its missiles and rotating saw blades could tear through any defense. However, when launching missiles or lasers, the vulnerable core on its head is briefly exposed — that is the only chance to paralyze it. Legend has it that someone once asked Ancient Steve why he left such an obvious weakness in such a powerful creation. Steve replied, "If it had no weakness, it would forget why it fights... Fine, I can't keep making this up. Actually, it's a design flaw — the core needs to dissipate heat." Realmwarden Realmwarden, formerly known as the Nameless Guardian, once fought alongside the Ancient Steve to seal away the Immortals, earning great distinction on the battlefield. Later, it was reforged into the Ultimate Guardian, inscribed with an iron law: "All who approach the portal shall be slain without mercy." It stands eternal, watching over the seal—the final warning to all who dare intrude. The Immortal The Immortal, a monster that lives for conquest, leads its Immortal Legion through countless dimensions, turning every place it sets foot into a battlefield. Until it breaks into the main world and encounters the Ancient Steve. For the first time, the Immortal faces such a daunting foe—Steve possesses the power of infinite respawn, each fall only heralding a stronger return. After a long and brutal clash, Ancient Steve, through the coordinated efforts of himself and his creations, finally seals the Immortal and its legion into the Void Crack. Future plans Corpse Warlock: Completely reworked Add a Boss with a stone element Add new dimension Add a new Illager Boss Nameless Guardian: Partial skill reset FAQs Q: I encountered a crash or a suspected bug while playing. How should I report it? A: Option 1: Create a new issue on the mod's GitHub, and attach the log file (if the issue is not related to a crash, it may not be necessary). Describe the problem you encountered and the version of the mod loader you are using. Option 2: You can post in the issues channel on my Discord server (please make sure to read the posting rules before doing so). Q: Will the Nameless Guardian be reworked? A: Not for now. Starting from version 0.98, the Nameless Guardian will no longer appear in regular survival gameplay, but can still be spawned via commands or spawn eggs, and related configurations will remain. Q: When will The Immortal and related content be updated? A: As one of the late-game bosses of this mod, due to a change in plans, the development cycle for this part will be extended across multiple versions. That is, each version may gradually update part of the content until it is finally completed. Q: Are there plans to port to higher versions / NeoForge? A: Yes, it's already on the planning list Q: How long is the update cycle between each new version? When will the next update be released? A: The general update interval is usually within 3 months for each version. If a version has crashes or bugs that severely affect the survival mode experience, a fix will be released in a short time (depending on the difficulty of fixing). EEEAB's Mobs is created by EEEAB as an individual, with their involvement covering the following areas: mobs lore and story creation, modeling and animation production, texture painting, building structure design, and coding.The areas not included are music and sound effect production. Since version 0.93, mods for version 1.19.2 will lag behind version 1.20.1 by one version. In other words, every time version 1.20.1 updates with two new mod versions, it will only be ported to version 1.19.2 once. After the official release of mod version 1.0, version 1.19.2 will no longer receive any content ports, only bug fixes and text translation updates. Version 1.18 and below will not be ported. No Fabric. Credits Thanks to Mowzie's Mobs mod, I’ve used the camera shake system, advanced particle system, and laser entity rendering from the mod. Without Bob Mowzie's selfless open-source contributions, EEEAB's Mobs wouldn't be what it is today. Origin of BGM: Guardians - Evan King The army of minotaur - Makai Symphony Realmwarden OST: "The Only Edict" was generated using Suno AI (Pro paid account). You are free to use this track in Minecraft mods and derivative content—no additional permission needed Thank leomard0 o for painting an excellent resource pack for my mod. title: Gnetum
description: Distribute HUD updates over multiple frames to improve performance
body: Gnetum A Minecraft mod that improves performance by distributing HUD updates over multiple frames. Overview Gnetum divides a full HUD update into multiple "passes." Only one pass is rendered each frame, reducing the time taken on HUD updates and improving FPS. Based on the rendering time of each element, Gnetum automatically distributes their updates over multiple frames, improving both the average FPS and the minimum. Technical explanations The idea behind Gnetum is to reduce the framerate of the HUD, which is not cheap to render and does not really change often, to improve the overall performance of the game, in a way that improves both the average and the minimum FPS. To achieve this: Gnetum employs two framebuffers, called a back framebuffer and a front framebuffer, respectively Each frame will render a "pass", that is, a (customizable) portion of the complete HUD, to the back framebuffer If the number of passes is set to 4, for example, a full HUD update is distributed over 4 frames, saving a lot of draw calls every frame and improving FPS After all passes finish rendering, the back framebuffer is "swapped" with the front framebuffer Each frame also renders the front framebuffer, which contains a texture of the full HUD There is also an HUD FPS limiter that defines the maximum FPS of the HUD. Configuration Starting from 4.0.0, integration is implemented with Sodium Config API. The configuration can be accessed from the Video Screen, allowing for adjustment of: the number of passes maximum HUD FPS enabling/disabling caching for each element Compatibility 1.20.1, 1.21.1 & 1.21.11 ✔️ ImmediatelyFast: fully compatible and recommended. 1.12.2 ⚠️ OptiFine: make sure "Fast Render" is disabled (this mod would do nothing otherwise.) ⚠️ StellarCore: make sure their HUD Caching feature is disabled (if you are unsure how to disable it you can ignore this: it's disabled by default.) Credits This mod is inspired by the HUDCaching mod by Moulberry.

title: Guard Villagers (Fabric/Quilt)
description: Guards that help with village pest control
body: This is a fabric port of Guard Villagers by almightytallestred for 1.18, get the original forge version here Are you tired of your village dying off because its golem is too lazy? Are you tired of essentially defending it all by yourself? This mod adds Guards as a solution, as well as new villager-related AI changes. Guards These spawn in villages in groups of six, equipped with either an iron sword or a crossbow. They're prepared to fight any threat to the village (possibly including you!). To make new guards, shift + right click on a nitwit or unemployed villager with a sword or crossbow. If you have hero of the village, they will gain the ability to follow and fight for you when you click the follow button, and right clicking them will open up the guard inventory, allowing you to give them armor, and swap out their weapons! For their offhand slot, you can either give them a shield, or some food. If they have a shield, they will use it to block attacks, crossbow guards with a shield won't be able to kick enemies if they're blocking. If they have food (or a potion), they will start eating or drinking if they are low on health. Clicking the patrol button will allow you to set patrol points for guards, melee guards will walk around the point while ranged guards will snipe enemies and stand still on their point. You will only be able to gain access to their inventory if you have hero of the village. AI Changes Witches attack villagers. true by default In raids, illagers kill any animal they see. f alse by default Villagers and Illagers are scared of polar bears. true by default Clerics heal low-health guards, villagers, and players with Hero of the Village using regeneration potions, and smiths repair iron golems with ingots.

title: Better Days
description: Gives you control over the passage of time by allowing you to customize the length of the day-night cycle and alters the Minecraft sleep mechanic by accelerating the speed of time.
body: A Minecraft 1.19+ mod designed to extend the length of the crazy short Minecraft day. Notice This mod was originally designed as a 1.15.2 mod. However, due to being too busy to update to 1.16.5, Hourglass mod was created. Now Hourglass hasn't received any updates in nearly a year, plus there are new features that needed added. I've revived Better days to update for not only 1.19 and 1.20, but also bring all the features to both Forge and Fabric . 1.19+ is a fork of the Hourglass mod, with new features and some functionality removed. 1.18.2 is a backport for both Forge and Fabric that contains all of the 1.19+ features and bug fixes. Differences from Hourglass Mod Commands removed. Forge only configuration screen removed. Syncing config updates with client. Now requires a restart. Added better support for Serene Seasons Features This mod (optionally) replaces the vanilla sleep functionality with a smooth and natural transition to morning by accelerating the passage of time while you're in bed. In multiplayer, time will pass faster depending on the percentage of players who are currently sleeping. This removes the need for any sleep voting system or player threshold, as any number of players can have an impact on the duration of the night. Better Days allows for customization of the day-night cycle duration , and can control day and night speed independently. Rather than the vanilla duration of 20 minutes, you can slow down time to make a day in Minecraft last as long as a day in real life, or speed up the passage of nights for a more forgiving experience. Better Days also provides a number of time effects that may speed up the progression of various elements in Minecraft to match the current speed of time. Some examples include crop growth, grass growth, weather, potion effects, furnaces, hoppers, etc. Most of these time effects are disabled by default but can be enabled by setting their associated config options. Compatibility Better Days is compatible with the following mods: Homeostatic Ready Player Fun Comforts Sleep Warp If mod is installed, the sleep system is disabled. Sleep Tight If mod is installed, the sleep system is disabled. Fabric Seasons Serene Seasons Enhanced Celestials Quark The Improved Sleeping module of Quark interferes with the sleep feature of Better Days. See note below. The "Nerf Clock" Quark option breaks the bed clock in Better Days. Either the Quark tweak should be disabled or the Better Days Bed Clock should be disabled via the displayBedClock config. Nomadic Tents Better Days is compatible with this mod. However, sleep causes an extra full day cycle to pass after waking. The Hordes Better Days is compatible with this mod. However, you MUST set hordeEventByPlayerTime = false, or it will not work at all. Immersive Snow Better Days is NOT compatible with this mod if using a season mod as well, as it completely overrides the day and night length. There is a configuration option to disable this behavior, but unfortunately, it is set to override Better Days by default. Sleep Vote Mods Better Days is compatible with mods that enable sleep voting or have sleep percentage systems like Quark and Morpheus, but they conflict with the sleep feature of this mod. These features should either be disabled in their corresponding mods, or the sleep feature in Better Days should be disabled. The sleep feature can be disabled via command or file by modifying the enableSleepFeature option. Other Compatibility Notes The Overworld is currently the only dimension supported. However, most dimensions in Minecraft (including custom dimensions) derive their time information from the Overworld and will therefore elapse time at the same rate. This mod does not save data to world files and can be safely removed from a Minecraft installation.

title: Silk
description: Kotlin Minecraft API - targetting Fabric, Quilt and Paper
body: Silk [ [sɪlk] ]( is a Minecraft API for Kotlin - targetting Fabric, Quilt and Paper. Join our Discord or Matrix Space Features of the API: an inventory GUI API a Kotlin wrapper for Brigadier a Kotlin DSL for creating complex Text objects coroutine utilities and tasks kotlinx.serialization support for Minecraft classes a scoreboard (sideboard) API ItemStack utilities serialization of any class to NBT with kotlinx.serialization an NBT builder an API for storing persistent data on Chunks, Entities etc kotlinx.serialization based networking (packets c2s, s2c and c2c) Kotlin Compose UI support general extensions for Entities, Worlds and more geometry utilities Docs The docs link can be found on Silk GitHub . Read them to get started with each module and see how to add it to your Gradle project. Note: Currently, the ingame ID of the wrapper mod is silk-all License Current versions of Silk are available under the GPL-3.0 , while older versions below 1.5.1 of (at that time FabrikMC) have been shared under the Apache-2.0 License.

title: Cobblemon: PlayerXP
description: Earn XP from battles alongside your pokemon.
body: PlayerXP Earn XP from battles alongside your pokemon. This mod works on both the client-side and server-side but will only need to be installed server-side to work on servers. Features This mod is simple, it rewards players alongside their pokemon with experience levels. This is important when playing cobblemon without mob spawns as the only other real XP income is from villagers. Config Options You can find the config file at: config/playerxp/playerxp.json shouldGiveLevels - true / false - whether to give levels instead of xp. baseXP - How much xp should be given to the player per pokemon level. baseLevels - How many levels should be awarded to the player per pokemon level if shouldGiveLevels is set to true. Dependencies Cobblemon: Modrinth / Curseforge Fabric-Loader: Fabric-Loader Fabric-Api: Modrinth / Curseforge Neoforge: Neoforge My Other Mods Affiliate

title: Adorable Hamster Pets
description: 3,000+ Wild Variants, Procedural Genetics, Shoulder Launching, Diamond Sniffing, Cheek Inventories, Personalities, 50+ Animations, Wander Modes, and much more!
body: The cutest, most useful pet in Minecraft. That's a bold claim, so allow me to demonstrate. Adorable Hamster Pets stuffs Minecraft with pint-sized, jiggly fur-missiles that have a craving for... diamonds. Perfect for anyone who surveys their diamond-encrusted empire and mutters, “Needs more rodents.” These hamsters like to bounce, shoulder-surf, hoard snacks, sniff for things, and moonlight as throwable projectiles, all while adding maximum charm and helping with your inventory clutter. Tame, feed, or yeet at will; (ethics optional). TL;DR Features, for the Impatient 3000+ Wild Variants – (discovery! science! questionable taming decisions!) Procedural Breeding – discover up to 2.2 million unique variants through breeding Acorn Armor – from biodegradable Acorn shells to Netherite plating Dynamic Animations – procedural napping, cleaning, and personality-based sit/sleep poses Wear Up to Three Hamsters – mount them on your shoulders & head, jiggle physics included Shoulder-Surfing Perks – portable creeper radar & diamond divination, powered by cheese Hamster Yeet™ (press G) – turns your shoulder buddies into furry, squeaky missiles Tamed Wander Mode – link them to Hamster Beds so they stop following you Item Stealing – hamsters play high-stakes keep-away with your valuables; highly configurable Potent Vegetables – stuff their face with Steamed Green Beans and witness the chaotic zoomies Diamond Sniffing – complete with dramatic sulking animations if they accidentally find gold instead Cheek Pouches of Holding – six inventory slots inside the hamster (cheeks visibly expand when full) Automatic Eating From Cheeks – they can snack on their own if they have Hamster Food Mix Wild Cucumber & Green Bean Bushes – use them for rodent bribes... or decor, if you're into that Cheese Crafting – surprisingly moist snack for players; hamsters find it intoxicating In-Game Guidebook – a wealth of ancient hamster knowledge, plus cozy illustrations Custom Advancement Tree – so you can gamify your rodent wrangling Global Loot Injection – find hamster gear in ancient loot chests; archaeologists baffled Hyper-Configurable – customize everything, from spawning to yeet velocity Widely-Compatible – all interactions & mechanics based on configurable c:tags Bribe them with Sliced Cucumber and they'll follow you like a furry, ankle-biting shadow. They have unique personalities that dictate how they sit and nap. Yes, they even have a dedicated "Path to Slumber" animation sequence. Lure up to three hamsters onto your person using Cheese . They aren't just static decorations; they are fully animated, physics-enabled passengers that bounce when you jump and hold on for dear life when you sprint. While up there, they act as portable radar systems, squeaking alerts for nearby Creepers and Diamonds . For when words fail and you need a furry, surprisingly aerodynamic solution— press 'G' . Behold as your shoulder companion becomes a surprisingly effective, albeit concussed, projectile. Includes satisfying particle trail, impact sound effects, and the Doppler Effect ! Does enough damage by default to kill a creeper, which is... really convenient. So, you want a server? I gotchu. I've researched many different server hosts and also tried a few myself. Until recently, I thought Apex Hosting was the best... until I tried Indifferent Broccoli . They deserve at least 7 out of 5 stars in my book. They are superior in every way: Top-Tier Hardware (they live up to their slogan of eating lag for breakfast) Full Modded Support (even on their cheapest servers. Apex doesn't offer that) Incredible Customer Service (you can literally just ping them on Discord and they fix it) Affordable (somehow cheaper than Apex Hosting while also being better :O) Approachable (just feels like a group of friends who love gaming) Uninterrupted Uptime (my server generated chunks 24/7 for 3 days lol) And I just recently discovered their Split the Cost feature. Your server comes with a payment link— toss it in the group chat, and your friends can directly contribute to the server's monthly bill in two seconds. Ridiculously easy. I thought it was so cool I give it its own paragraph LOL. Sign up by clicking the banner above. You'll get yourself a great server AND help fund my hamster shenanigans for future updates! Throw a hamster at an Oak Tree . It will vanish into the canopy, physically rustling the leaves and raining down Acorns . You can use the acorns to craft Acorn Armor and the stylish Acorn Hat accessory. Craft a Hamster Bed , link it to your hamster, and place it. They will stop following you and wander freely near their bed. If they get stuck somewhere, just go to sleep— they'll find their way home during the night. Comes with numerous interactive controls specific to each bed. P.S. - Don't place the bed upside down. Just don't do it. If they smell diamonds while on your shoulder, put them down. They will lead you to the ore. Note: they sometimes mistake Gold for Diamond, and will exhibit a dramatic sulking animation when they realize their error. They'll energetically implement hamster kung fu on enemies. They like round-house kicks. Even includes particle effects on their feet. Craft Acorn Armor (works like Wolf Armor, negates all damage until it breaks). Upgrade it with Smithing Templates found in chests: Iron: Aerodynamic. Reduces wind resistance for a faster throw. Gold: Lightweight. Grants a permanent movement speed buff. Diamond: The "Expensive Therapy" upgrade. Cures kleptomania. A diamond-clad hamster is so satisfied with its own shininess that it will fetch shiny things for you instead of stealing them. Netherite: Dense. Grants Knockback Resistance and massive throw impact damage. Your hamster's love for shiny things may have evolved into full-blown kleptomania. Unless wearing Diamond armor, they will steal valuable items dropped on the floor and run away with them. Catch them to retrieve your loot (just diamonds by default; configurable). OUTDATED AS OF v3.6.0 - UNDER CONSTRUCTION 73+ variants spawn based on biome (White in snow, Black in caves, Lavender in magical biomes). Compatible with Terralith/Biomes O' Plenty/Oh the Biomes You'll Go out of the box. Configurable enough to work with any other mod that adds custom biomes. When bred, they pass their diverse fur coat palettes on to their offspring, with a polite attempt to not exactly copy their parents' overlay patterns, ensuring maximum genetic variety in your ever-growing population. A Field Guide to Hamster Habitats Orange & Cream: The most common type, often found sunning themselves in Plains, Savannas, Deserts, and non-frigid Beaches. Badlands also seem to attract the Orange ones. Chocolate: Prefers the shaded canopy of Forests and non-snowy Taigas (excluding Cherry Groves, those are special). Black: Enjoys the damp ambiance of wet biomes like swamps and the mysterious depths of the Deep Dark. Light Gray & Dark Gray: These stoic shades are common in non-frozen mountainous regions and also share cave real estate with their Black brethren. White: Exclusively found in most snowy biomes (Plains, Taiga, Groves, etc.) and makes up about 30% of the population in the extremely chilly Ice Spikes. Blue: A master of glacial camouflage. This rare variant's cool, blue-tinted fur is an uncanny match for the shimmering ice and packed snow of the most frigid landscapes. While vary rare in the default game, (only spawns in Ice Spikes), its love for ice means it might also be spotted in other crystalline wonderlands added by mods. Lavender: Less about survival and more about style, this variant's dusty purple coat is a perfect match for the fantastical flora of magical biomes. Look for them amidst the pink petals of Cherry Groves and the strange hues of Mushroom Fields. Their preference for the peculiar means you might also find them in other enchanted forests or mystical groves added by mods. Feed them Hamster Food Mix to earn their trust and cheek pouch access. Sneak + Right-Click to access 6 inventory slots. They will automatically eat Hamster Food Mix from here if hurt. For reasons known only to Notch himself, Ravagers and Spiders are utterly terrified of hamsters. The mere sight of a tiny ball of fluff will send these hulking monstrosities fleeing in the opposite direction. Highly effective crowd control, especially if you have arachnophobia. You get one automatically the first time you join a world (unless you turned that off in the config, you rebel). It contains tips . Read it. Or use it as kindling, but don't come crying into the Discord server unless you've read it first. Need a new one? Craft it with minecraft:book + adorablehamsterpets:sliced cucumber , or get a new one for free by vising the config and clicking the "I Lost My Book" button. You can also grab it from the Creative Mode tab if you're lazy. Cucumber and Green Bean Bushes Cucumbers : Found in warm or dry biomes (Plains, Savannas, Jungles). Right-click seeded bushes to harvest. Essential for crafting Sliced Cucumber , the only currency wild hamsters accept for taming. Green Beans : Found in wet or temperate areas (Swamps, Lush Caves, Flower Forests). Harvest these to craft Steamed Green Beans , a potent performance-enhancing drug for small rodents. Slightly Less Useless Sunflowers Vanilla sunflowers merely exist; mine produce . Right-click the head to harvest Sunflower Seeds (used for food mix). They naturally replace vanilla sunflowers in valid biomes. They can be farmed and will regrow seeds eventually. Be patient. New Food Stuffs Cucumber/Green Beans: Grow 'em, eat 'em raw (if you must), slice 'em, steam 'em. Culinary possibilities are… present. Wild hamsters go nuts for these. Steamed Green Beans: A suspiciously potent super-food for your hamster. Grants temporary buffs, followed by a mandatory "please wait" period. Don't get greedy. Hamster Food Mix: Allegedly gourmet. Heals well, bypasses their irritating pickiness, and is the key to unlocking their cheek pouches. Craft it. Or don't. Your hamster, your problem. Cheese: Not only can it lure hamsters onto your shoulder, it's player-edible. Surprisingly nutritious (think cooked porkchop levels) and you can scarf it down about 30% faster than most foods. The only catch? The... distinctively moist eating sound. Consider it an acquired taste. Its nutritional value is fully configurable, for those of you who felt cheese was somehow "unbalanced." Plebs. Feed your hamster Steamed Green Beans to trigger a state of pure, unadulterated zoomies. They gain substantial buffs to Speed, Strength, and Regeneration, and will proceed to run energetic circles around you (complete with particle trails) until the sugar crash hits. This humble pile of leaves and twigs, officially known as Hamster Bedding , is the cornerstone of hamster interior design. You'll need it to craft the aforementioned Hamster Beds . But its true calling? Unnecessary ambiance. Right-click the item in the air (or put it in a Dispenser ) to unleash a glorious poof of decorative leaf particles. These aren't just any particles. Oh no. I've blessed them with a ridiculously over-engineered client-side physics simulation. They float with a gentle pendulum sway, react to a universal wind drift that slowly changes direction over a three-minute cycle, (or stays static if you toggle it) and are subject to "spatially-coherent wind gusts"—a fancy way of saying they all realistically blow in the same direction at the same time. I even created an "indoors/outdoors" detection algorithm so the system is even smart enough to know when it's indoors, regardless of how you built your house or what materials you used. This system disables the wind effects indoors so you don't get a sudden gust of wind in your hobbit hole. You already have enough going on in there. It's deeply unnecessary, and I'm incredibly satisfied with it. P.S. - Remember, don't place your hamster bed upside down. Don't even think about it. Hamsters have a dedicated Bling inventory slot. Right-click them (or use their inventory) to equip accessories. Use Pink Petals for pure style points, or the Acorn Hat to boost yields during Tree Heists. Many more fashion items are planned for future updates! Future Accessory Plans The current accessory collection is... sparse, but the hamster haberdashery is just getting started. The Discord community suggestion box is overflowing with ideas that range from "brilliant" to "medically concerning," so future updates might just include some of the following hamster adornments: Adventuring Gear: For the hamster with heroic delusions. Think tiny swords, shields, armadillo armor, and even a dried kelp eye-patch. Fruit-Themed Headwear: Because who doesn't want a hamster wearing a tiny banana? More Flower Decoration Types: We've already got pink petals, but we need ALL THE COLORS. Hats and Crowns: Flower crowns for when your hamster needs to feel like the tiny, unelected monarch of the forest floor, and top hats for absolute sophistication. And much, much more... These are subject to change! Got a genius idea for the next hamster accessory that absolutely needs to exist? Think you've designed the perfect tiny helmet? Bring your brilliant, weird, and wonderful ideas to The Cheek Pouch Discord Server. Make sure you select "Share Your Genius" in the screening questions to get the @Idea Generator role, and then unleash your creativity in the suggestions channel. A custom advancements tab, "The Hamster Life," guides you through the thrilling world of hamster husbandry, from finding your first seed to... um, yeeting. The goal was a subtle, spoiler-lite tutorial system designed for people who hate reading manuals (I know you're out there). If you're ever wondering "what am I supposed to do with this rodent?" , just press L and check the advancements tree. It follows a logical progression, gently nudging you from basic foraging and taming all the way up to advanced mechanics like cheek-pouch management, bed linking, and the various... jiggly physics experiments . If you follow the advancements, you'll naturally discover most features in the mod without needing to tab out to your browser every three minutes. Plus, I spent way too much time writing the unique titles and descriptions for each one, so they are worth checking out. You might even experience a small chuckle. Go Outside: Wander aimlessly through Plains, Savannas, Forests, Swamps, etc., until you trip over Wild Cucumber Bushes or Wild Green Bean Bushes . Right-click the ones that look like they have seeds. Collect said seeds. Pretend to Farm: Plant seeds on farmland. Wait. Harvest. Try not to starve while waiting for virtual vegetables. Questionable Crafting: Turn Cucumbers into Sliced Cucumber (the bait). Turn Green Beans into Steamed Green Beans via furnace (for buffs). Cobble together various seeds and carrots into Hamster Food Mix (for healing). Turn Milk into Cheese (the Shoulder Shenanigans starter kit). Refer to your recipe book, I'm not writing recipes here. Attempt Taming: Find a wild hamster. Sneak . Hold Sliced Cucumber . Approach like you're diffusing a tiny, furry bomb. Click. Repeat until successful or rage-quit. Basic Hamster Operations: Right-click to sit/stand. Sneak + Right-click for cheek inventory access (after feeding Food Mix!). Wave Cheese around to shoulder-mount. By default, you crouch to dismount, or Press 'G' to dismount... rapidly . However, the whole dismounting process is highly configurable. You can choose between a single or double tap, and also set a custom keybind if you like. Total Control Uses Fzzy Config for configuration. If you have Mod Menu, click the button. If not, venture into the config/adorablehamsterpets folder and edit main.toml by hand like some kind of digital caveman. Thanks to the magic of Fzzy Config, all the server-side settings are validated and synced from the server. That means if you have a server, you set the rules. Whatever you decide the taming difficulty, hamster damage, or acceptable cheese nutrition levels are, your players will abide by it. They can't change these core settings locally unless you give them the keys to the kingdom. A few purely cosmetic client-side settings are the exception, but the important stuff? That's all you. There are no hard-coded hamster interaction items— everything can be modified. Redefine their diet. Make your hamsters demand Nether Stars for taming. Make them steal only dirt blocks. Whatever. Live your truth. Fine-tune the physics. Adjust the velocity, damage, and cooldown of the Hamster Yeet. Tweak the potency of the Green Bean zoomies. Become a cheese tycoon, or nerf it into the ground. The nutritional value of cheese is fully configurable and even syncs with AppleSkin 's HUD on Minecraft 1.21.1 (older versions are out of luck due to API shenanigans). Out-of-the-Box Harmony From the beginning the goal was to make this play nice with the big names. Hamster spawning is pre-tuned for gorgeous world-gen mods like Terralith , so your lavender hamsters will actually show up in lavender fields, but It also works with massive mods like Oh The Biomes You'll Go and Biomes O' Plenty , though expect to see a lot of the common orange variant until I've had enough coffee to map out their 8,000+ biomes. (As of version 3.4.0, you can now do this yourself! Check Config Hamster Spawn Settings Variant Spawning by Biome ) Wild bushes and sunflowers should pop up just fine in any modded landscape, but if you run into issues, you can tweak the settings: Config Worldgen: Bush & Sunflower Stuff . Thanks to some glorious assistance from @CasualAnimalEnjoyer , this mod is also compatible with the following mods by default: Farmer's Delight Cultural Delights Croptopia Immersive Engineering Serene Seasons Botany Pots Immersion, Because Details 💅🏼 The sound effect and particle systems are smart enough to keep up with customized items. For example, if you mount your hamster with an emerald instead of cheese, it won't make a "squish" sound anymore; it'll make a satisfying "clink" and sparkle with emerald particles. This dynamic system applies to most interactions, ensuring the audio and visual feedback always matches your custom configuration. (Even works with custom modded items!) Want to make a gameplay video? A review? An addon that gives them tiny hats? A parody song about the cheese economy? Go for it. I love seeing the stuff this community creates, and I want to keep it welcoming. However, please don't use my branding (the logo, specific asset art, or official-sounding social posts) to advertise your own stuff. Nah fam. The Legal Stuff If you're thinking about rummaging through the files, here's the deal: The Assets (Textures, Models, Sounds, Animations) are All Rights Reserved . They belong to me. Please do not steal them. The Code (The Java logic) is under the LGPL v3.0 license. Feel free to learn from it, fork it, or use it, provided you follow the rules of the license (keep it open source, state changes, etc.). Need to use the brand or assets for something specific? Feel free to ask me on The Cheek Pouch Discord server! Credits & Dependencies This mod is made possible by a legion of translators, patrons, library authors, and contributors. View the full Credits & Hall of Fame here. Getting Support & Contributing Found a bug? Want to help translate? Check out the Contribution & Support Guide . Now go enjoy the squeaks. Or mute them. Whatever.

title: Modpack Update Checker
description: An update checker designed for modpacks!
body: Modpack Update Checker is a Minecraft mod that allows players to check for updates to their modpack. It supports both Fabric and Forge mod loaders, and is designed to be easy to configure and use. The mod uses JSON files hosted on Github to store changelogs and version information, and can display this information in-game through a custom GUI. The goal of this project is to provide an easy-to-use and customizable solution for modpack developers and players to stay up-to-date with the latest modpack versions and changelogs. By automating the update checking process, players can quickly and easily update their modpacks without having to manually check for updates or download files from external sources.
